head: 7129412bbb0a3a85815563147f291bb46dcab06a

states.covers: Chart-first monitor view with a loaded report (spot 22,363, candles, EMA9 overlay legend, OI chain, movers, walls and heatmap at 1600). Full HH:MM time-axis ticks asserted in-browser at both widths; stale freshness 44d.

DESK view with real panel content (chart, chain, walls, flow, options analytics and a populated movers strip with TCS/INFY/WIPRO). No section error banner; full HH:MM time-axis ticks asserted at both widths.

DESK > OPTIONS ANALYTICS after a real page.click on the GEX tab: aria-pressed=true on GEX, false on Futures, and a populated GEX profile panel (net -142.60 Cr/pt, zero cross 22,350, gamma ramp) visible at both viewports.
MONITOR view with the ALL STATS disclosure opened via nifty-live-tape-toggle; bounded popover shows the report snapshot including spot 22,363. Full HH:MM time-axis ticks asserted at both widths.
Report shell while nifty-report-loading is visible (MOCKED: delayed /api/reports/nifty/live route handler).
Report shell error banner (MOCKED: /api/reports/nifty/live fulfilled with HTTP 500 and detail 'mock failure'); exactly one alert carries the failure copy.

App's real no-payload fallback reached by selecting EOD with no session date; nifty-report-empty-reason names the last recorded snapshot ('Snapshot 10:00 · 2026-10-12 — no live report for this selection').

notes: Recaptured with a temporary 14-test Playwright harness at UI head 20510c0a997b197a6d53853d6fd5e3d8df9b5689 ('fix: reserve chart axis gutter for full time labels'), overwriting the previous head-2db3dcd1 set. The temp spec is deleted after capture; no git writes were made.

Loaded/GEX/popover frames use setupApiMocks, loginAsTestUser, setupNiftyTapeMocks and setupNiftyReportMocks plus enriched report/tape/walls/movers route payloads so no window is left in Loading or NO DATA; the app renders the real UI from those seeded responses. The report payload sets market.is_open=true for real movers rows (the shell's MARKET CLOSED chrome comes from the app market clock) and carries a full GEX block so the GEX tab shows real profile values rather than dashes.
GEX is selected by a real Playwright click on report-analytics-tab-gex after the DESK view opens; aria-pressed flips to true and Futures to false before the screenshot.

Time-axis assertion: the production chart has no chart-time-first-label / chart-time-last-label DOM nodes (those testids exist only in NiftyChartPanel.geometry.test.tsx's TradingViewChart mock). The harness therefore patches CanvasRenderingContext2D.fillText scoped to nifty-chart-wrap, asserts --chart-time-label-gutter is 24px and data-pinned-candles is 10, then checks the first and last drawn tick texts are complete HH:MM with their measured boxes inside the chart canvas. At 1600 they are 09:15 and 10:00; at 390 the engine drops intermediate ticks and shows 09:30 and 10:00, both complete.

loading and error are deliberately mocked with Playwright route handlers; no live server state can produce them on demand. snapshot-empty is not mocked: it is the application's own no-payload selection state with a single explicit reason line.
All 14 PNGs are viewport-sized captures (1600x1000 and 390x844) and were read back after writing to confirm complete 09:15 / 10:00 labels at 1600 and 09:30 / 10:00 at 390.
